context: A uni student listens to a teen friend air a long-bottled thought
purpose: Teach: 化粧/度目/黙っ/溢れ/目撃/勘違い/愛する/悲しみ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: れん先輩、ちょっと聞いてほしいことがあって、ずっと黙ってたんですけど…
lines.en: Ren, there's something I want you to hear, I've been keeping it quiet...
lines.style: Hesitant teen voice, soft and tentative opening

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: どうした、なんか今日、化粧もいつもと違うし、目が赤いぞ。
lines.en: What's up? Your makeup looks different today, and your eyes are red.
lines.style: Gentle uni-student concern, observant older friend tone

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 実は、彼が他の子と歩いてるとこを目撃しちゃって、もう三度目なんです。
lines.en: Actually, I saw him walking with another girl, and it's the third time now.
lines.style: Trembling confession, voice cracking with hurt teenager

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 三度目か…それは勘違いじゃ済まないやつだな。
lines.en: Third time, huh... that's not something you can write off as a misunderstanding.
lines.style: Quiet uni-student sigh, measured and serious reaction

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 私、本気で愛する人ができたって思ってたのに、涙が溢れて止まらなくて…
lines.en: I really thought I'd found someone to love, but the tears just won't stop...
lines.style: Tearful teen breakdown, raw emotional outpouring released

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: その悲しみ、無理に飲み込まなくていいよ。今日くらい全部吐き出せ。
lines.en: You don't have to swallow that sadness. Today, let it all out.
lines.style: Warm uni-student reassurance, big-brotherly grounded support

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先輩…ありがとうございます。話したら、ちょっとだけ楽になりました。
lines.en: Thank you, Ren... talking about it made me feel a little lighter.
lines.style: Soft teen exhale, fragile gratitude finally surfacing through tears
